He says, you take that back.

lines.subtitles: The hamster knows a suspicious mammal when he sees one.
**innocent meows**
The cute act will not work on him. He is the master of it.
Winston!
Venture!
Winston!
Venture.
Winston!
Uh... **whispers** Hey, is he okay?
Winston! You've let yourself go.
I-I haven't! *(pause)* Maybe just a little bit.
We will go to the gym together. After the mission. Tonight.
F-for how long?
I will tell you when we are done.
Can you build me a bike? Money's no object.
He is an artist, not a mechanic.
All right. How about a new chassis for Bob?
That is... intriguing.
**curious beeps**
**hamster noises**
**fascinated beeps**
Alert: translation buffer full.
Hammond, did you eat Ganymede's birdfeed again?
He asks whether it's still called birdfeed if a hamster eats it.
That's a shame! I'll be giving these cookies I made to teammates who deserve them...
Translation failure. Profanity database error.
You've got a lot of armor for a little guy!
The hamster's temper is rising.
I wonder how Mitzi would look in armor like that...
Champ! I need ya to make me something else.
A robot guard dog for me dirt garden. Maybe it can fly. You decide.
A suit of armor, right? But one... that shouts my name!
I need a slop bucket that's bulletproof, and don't you dare ask why!
A grenade launcher with one trigger, three barrels. Paint, glitter, and nails.
He says, "fine, but give me a challenge next time."
The Champ himself! Can you sign my forehead?
He does not do autographs.
Hey, Champ! Why've you got that wombat riding around with ya?
He is the pilot.
Ha! And I'm "President of the Moon!" Seriously though, what's he for...?
Please move along.
Champ! Which of your glorious victories was your favorite?
The hamster is tired of your questions.
Mine was when you beat Three-Arm Luke. Oh, you gave him the what-for!
Be advised: the hamster has an instinctive fear of foxes.
Is it because he looks delicious?
He says, "Yes, and damn right I do."
The hamster has a message for your fox.
...That's not how it works.
The mammal is disappointed.
Hey! Someone repaired my turret while I was napping!
He says, "you're welcome."
Isn't it reckless to pull enemies towards us?
**laughs** Afraid of getting too close?
Nope, just thinking of the team. It would help if you did too.
Mako, the Wreckers want you back. Thought you might like to know.
**meaningful grunt**
Ha! They'll hate that. I'll pass it along.
Say bacon one more time.
"Bacon, one more time."
I like your mask!
**grunt**
I said I like your mask, dude.
Okay.
You stole a lot of things that Helix was supposed to protect.
What's it to you?
My unit would have eaten you alive.
**laughter**
Those who seek only to enrich themselves live the most impoverished lives of all.
**sigh**
Yeah? And those who seek my wrath tend to find it.
That's why I'm an artist.
If you weren't so focused on putting me behind bars, you might finally notice the ones around yourself.
Was that a taunt, Niran? I can hardly hear you with how far you've fallen off the academy's pedestal.
**sigh** Another deflection. I hope someday you'll listen.
I don't know why you're so happy to kill. I've never enjoyed it, even for the worst people.
Oh, always with the guilt and the regret. Don't you humans know how to have any fun?
How could we, with the likes of you around?
I admire your silhouette, Singhania. It's so... maverick, pairing those arms with that coat.
Aww, thank you! It's truly humbling to earn the adulations of such a... fashion provocateur.
What do you make your bootlickers call you? "Vishkar Queen, Ruler of All Hard Light"?
**snickers** That would be "Vice President of Development and Operations". I'm not royalty.
Really? Even I'd consider bending the knee, for you.
Well... I suppose I *would* look dazzling in a crown.
*Echo-o-o-o! Echo-o-o-o-o-o-o!...* You aren't going to keep that label, are you?
I quite like my name. Dr. Liao chose it for me.
Exactly. She only saw you as her copy... and to the rest, you're just her faded memory.
Ugh! I don't know how you stand it, pretending to listen when the humans talk.
I'm not pretending. I've met many brilliant humans, and I have so much to learn.
Like what? How to hurt, and hate, and kill?
I choose what lessons I take with me. I hope someday, you'll do the same.
You know, the first time I saw you, I thought you were handsome.
And then, you learned I was a Shimada?
I learnt you were human... and I'm much pickier when it comes to flesh.
How would you rate our prison cells? I'm looking to make them worse.
I am shocked you keep them at all, given the rumors about your past...
They're all true. But *I* hold the keys, now... and I make for a cruel warden.
If Hanamura was in my hands, the first thing I'd do is tear down that ugly castle.
Hm. Fitting behavior for one who has never had a place to call home...
Dishonor your bloodline recently? Or was that your brother?
Oh, that's right. It's a family habit. *(giggle)*
Are you listening to me, Shimada?!
Mm... The wind blows loudly today.
No. Not at all.
If I see your bike on *my* turf, I'm slashing your tires.
And if I see *you*, I'll slash much more than that.
Count your days. You Hashimoto will *pay* for the lives you've ruined.
**sighs** You take away one whelp's daddy, and you never hear the end of it!
Dad's greatest creations were for the people he cherished most. Those pistols will never compare.
Oh, they measure up. I threatened your poor father's life to make sure of it.
His creations reflect our souls. You don't even have one.
Of course not. I don't need that kind of dead weight.
You have such a... pristine face. Did you design it yourself?
Why, you flatter me! But I assure you, I've made no alterations.
So what if you had? Even the most beautiful faces can be improved with the stroke of a knife.
Oh! Well... if you say so.
Is something wrong, Obake-kun? You look nervous.
Why do you care?
I will *always* care about you. Have I not made that clear?
I... **sigh** You have.
I hate to think of what misfortune you'll bring your new "friends..." **sigh** All because you exist.
Shut. Up.
Poor, poor Obake-kun... once a cursed demon child, always a cursed demon child.
I said... *SHUT UP!*
How dare you turn your back on me? Don't you remember what happens to those who step out of line?
Trust me. I couldn't forget if I tried.
Those silly Yōkai didn't change you that much. Deep down, you're the same cursed boy.
You don't know that.
Of course I do. No one knows you better, Mizuki.
Whatever they've told you about me, Mizuki... it isn't true!
No one's said anything. I'm just seeing you for what you are.
What I am? You mean, a "bot"? An empty killing machine?!
That's-- I didn't mean-- **huffs** I'm sorry.
What have you done to yourself? Living as a hollow facsimile of our oppressors.
Ha! Would you rather I kept the scars they gave me?
There is strength in our struggle, sister.
Thank the Iris for your wisdom. I'd have hated to learn that the hard way.
Your attempts to find power within human structures are misguided.
You think you're better than them? You'd shackle me, all the same.
Though you may not believe it, I am attempting to bring us peace.
**scoff** What a worthless, impossible dream.
That train ride was oh so fun, Vivi! Next time, we should fight to the death.
I don't have time to ruin your plans again... but I'm sure my agents would love the chance.
Your agents? No! That won't have the same spark.
You have disappointed me, Shion. Your latest failure will not come without consequence.
Oh, no. Whatever will you do? Put your little pocket knife to my throat?
You may not bleed, omnic, but I assure you, there are many paths to death.
Talk all you like, human... my bullets won't wait for you to finish.
Oi! Crossbow! You the bounty hunter who grabbed Machete Betty?
Who wants to know?
Uh, me? That's why I asked, bola for brains!
Ah... good to know Betty's friends are as sharp as she is.
I've met *mozzies* with more brains than you, Fawkes.
With all due respect, milady, I believe that's a knock against the Junkertown education system.
We've got an education system?
My exquisitous Queen, I come bearing news of great import!
Not now, Ratjunk.
My name's Junkrat!
No, it isn't.
I hear you like to prey on omnics. Try *me.*
No, thanks. Fought a bunch of ya before. You're a bit... gimmicky, no offense.
*"Gimmicky?"*
I said, "no offense!"
Lucky you hitched your wagon to me, wolf girl. I've been dreaming of a takeover for ages.
And a spectacle it shall be. Fight loud, and I will handle the aftermath.
You sure you want me keeping you alive? I am a human, after all.
A helpful human would certainly be a welcome change of pace.
You appear to have a... bird following you. Why?
*(explanatory beeps)*
Interesting. Well, if I see any twigs, I will let you know.
Are you satisfied following humans around like an observant pet?
There's no shame in learning from others. Try it sometime!
How come you don't stay a big bloke all the time?
I prefer tactical precision over brute force.
Oh, likewise, likewise. Some of my favorite bombs are *extraordinarily* precise!
Jamison Fawkes, reporting live. Let's ask this scary metal bloke how *he* thinks the battle's gonna go!
You are not a journalist.
A... puzzling prognostication. Now back to Natasha for a look at the weather!
Your... willingness, to experiment on your own kind... fascinates me, Doctor. Why do you do it?
I'm surprised you have to ask. We have an enemy in common.
Overwatch?
No. *Mortality.*
Your armor is interesting. What does it use as a power source?
Planning to steal it for your own designs? Heh, nice try.
I was being polite. Frankly, it's a little primitive for my tastes.
You were one of Anubis's jailers. You should have destroyed it.
That is... not what I would have expected you to say.
Of course not. You *humans* love your assumptions.
Putting those vile helmets on your own kind... Have you no honor?
I will not sacrifice my kind to abide by humanity's moral code.
It is surprising that you would resist freedom for omnics. I'd heard you championed our cause.
Maybe my optics need calibrating, because I don't see any "freedom" in indoctrination.
So, how much RAM do you have... RAMattra?
Do humans find comfort in such petty humor?
Just trying to break the ice!
Your invasion has left millions in disarray.
Harsh words, considering that your corporation benefits at their expense. You're welcome, by the way.
I've always wanted to make Aurora's pilgrimage to the Shambali Monastery!
The monks do not mind humans. What is stopping you?
I don't know. Maybe I have... asthma?
**sigh** Asthma.
Tell me, is it true you never miss?
Everyone misses.
That wasn't an answer.
I don't owe you one.
You seem in high spirits, Reinhardt.
Who wouldn't be, after a date with the most amazing woman in the world?!
**laughs** If you're acting this way already, I fear for our next date.
There's a next date? Haha! Wunderbar!
What a glorious day! The sun is smiling upon us. Hello, sun!
He knows it won't say hello back, right?
Yeah! Well, I'm pretty sure, anyway.
How are the grandkids, Torbjörn?
Lucas has gotten so big, you wouldn't believe it. **chuckles** The twins pull him into all their pranks!
Oh, no. Their poor cat!
If you're going to ask me to lighten up, save it. I've heard it enough times.
Nonsense. I know happiness is not always easy to come by.
Oh, I didn't think anyone else understood.
We all have our battles, my friend. And for us, every single is a victory.
A cat? In a jetpack?! **laugh** You’ve got to be catting me! **laugh**
**confused meows**
Reinhardt... I do believe it's 'kitten' me.
Uh... shouldn't it be 'kitten' me?
Ugh, trust me. I've already tried.
Don't be ridiculous. She's not a baby!
Mr. Wilhelm, I'm working on me résumé. What sounds better: "itinerant scoundrel," or "perspicacious rapscallion"?
**chuckle** Is there room for both?
I *knew* you were the right bloke to ask! Haha!
You look familiar. Are you the loud one?
No, I am Reinhardt Wilhelm! The one with the hammer and shield!
But not the loud one. Sure.
Hammer Man! Any German music you recommend?
Krankenwagen Grün. Haha, the best band of the 2030's!
Never heard of them.
What? They defined Techno-polka! You young people have no culture at all.
How are the grandkids, Torbjörn?
Märta just finished another vampire manuscript. I'm supposed to read it, but... well, you know.
What? I love her stories! Send it to *me!*
Do you ever wish you were back in medieval times?
A true knight's valor is timeless, little historian. The world needs us now.
Yeah, cool. **pause** ...But imagine living in a castle, though!
**laughs** I suppose that does sound tempting!
My life was forever changed in this place. It pains me to see it forgotten.
Will you tell me what happened here? I'll always remember--promise!
It would be an honor, my friend.
A cat? In a jetpack?! **laugh** You’ve got to be catting me! **laugh**
**confused meows**
Reinhardt… I do believe it’s “‘kitten’ me”.
Don’t be ridiculous. She’s not a baby!
Ha! Magnificent electromagnetism!
You were pretty magnificent yourself, Doc.
Ha! Up top, Doctor!
Hm? Up where?
Too slow! Um... never mind...
Hm... why does this place feel familiar?
We've been here, viejito. This is where Max lives.
Ah, yes, Maximilien! His collection of Greek sculptures is quite charming.
I must say, Brigitte, you've really proven yourself. You have your father's smarts, Reinhardt's bravery.
Aw, thanks. But not the charging or yelling, right?
Not yet. You still have work to do.
In Egypt, cats were often seen as fierce protectors.
*(questioning meows)*
And yet you seem more likely to protect your kibble.
How's our base looking these days, sweetheart? You fix that Bob-shaped hole in the wall yet?
Why don't you swing by? See for yourself. We'll even throw you a little welcome party.
I'm sure it'll be a real barn burner.
I'll bring the fireworks.
You've been in the fight a long time. Ever consider a life beyond battle?
Sometimes, but I think any chance of that is long gone.
I used to think that, too, brother. But believe me, there's always another path to take.
Yeah. I'll keep that in mind.
You getting homesick, too? Huh. Guess we were never good at sticking anywhere too long.
Maybe not.
Well, wherever you wind up, if you ever need a gunslinger, you can always count on me.
And if you ever have a need of my blade, it is yours.
When exactly are you planning to come clean to the others that you're ex-Talon?
You may be forgetting that the last time someone found out, he tried to kill me.
That was me, but Vivian's got her head on straight. She'd understand.
I'll think about it.
The manner in which you have enhanced yourself with cybernetics is quite exciting.
I've always felt that my modifications are just an extension of myself.
Curious. I have felt that myself is an extension of my modifications.
Doesn't matter how many upgrades you get, Echo. You'll still be you.
You have been acting strangely since returning from Grand Mesa.
Yeah. An old friend I ran into. She uh gave me a lot to think about.
I see. Are you going to leave, Cassidy?
Let's save it for after this mission.
You've been off since Grand Mesa. Everything all right?
I don't know. I guess I didn't expect to see our old teammates.
I'm sure they'd take you back. You don't have to stick around with Talon.
I know. I know.
You really think you'll find answers working with Talon?
I don't know. But, it feels like my only option.
Then we'll see it through.
This serum from Grand Mesa, how's your boss planning to use it?
You're suddenly interested in what becomes of our bounties, are we?
No. Just staying informed.
Continue supplying my experiments, and the entire world will know the results soon enough.
Mizuki, you should have stopped climbing walls.
What? Why?
It is a valuable skill.
Ugh, what's wrong with you people?
I am glad you have chosen a side, brother. I have always been on yours
If only I had understood that sooner.
Backing the Hashimoto was a mistake. The sons of Shimada will not rest until Talon is cleared from our streets.
Good. The restless are careless and easy to put down.
It was reckless of you to take on the Hashimoto in that arcade. Be grateful Kiriko and I came to help.
From what I hear, she once helped you escape a similar predicament.
That was different.
I would never suggest otherwise.
**sigh** I wish I'd had control over my own fate that day...
Yeah, I've been there too.
Yeah, we've all been there.
Can you keep a secret?
*(affirmative meow)*
Sometimes I rehearse my conversations with Chuño before I have them for real.
You want a treat?
*(enthusiastic meow)*
Me too, if only someone would give us one.
*(agreeing meow)*
Hi. What is Perú like?
It's a beautiful place.
Yeah, yeah, but is it worth conquering?
If you don't mind getting blasted to pieces by the power of the sun.
Hunt any foxes recently?
Can't say that I have. All the ones I've seen recently are runts.
Guess you'll find other ways to turn a profit.
Watch it, sugar.
You make some impressive copies of Dad's animal avatars.
Thank you. That functionality should be near 99.99% accurate.
Not trying to beat the real thing, I hope.
I wouldn't dare.
If you're willing to share, how did you know that you were non-binary?
It was like, you know that feeling when you've been puzzling over a ruin for weeks and then you find that one clay urn that brings the whole story together?
I can't say I'm familiar.
Oh. Well, it's like that.
You should be careful making deals with Moira.
I assure you, she and I have an equal partnership. If you're trying to turn me against her, you won't succeed.
Perhaps, but you should know she's not so agreeable as she appears to be.
Do not assume my ignorance. I know her nature as well as my own.
You did the right thing leaving Vishkar behind. The rest of those drones ought to take notes.
Well, I'm sure it's not so simple for everyone.
Get real, man. You think walking away is harder than ruining people's lives?
At Vishkar? You'd be surprised.
I know of a procedure that could tame those emotions of yours.
Let me remind you what happened last time I had an operation.
That serum you retrieved is coming along nicely, Emre. You're rather useful when you care to show up.
Well, I'd hate to make your life too easy.
Our facility's data on the Inti Warriors was corrupted recently. Would you happen to know who'd do such a thing?
No, but whoever did it was keeping our secret safe from monsters like you.
No matter. Rest assured, I will work tirelessly to salvage what remains.
I always heard the gangs out west were small-time. Isn't working with Talon a little ambitious?
Come on now. Can't fault a girl for dreaming big, can you?
I can fault her for armed robbery.
Ugh, details.
I'll hand it to you. You've turned Talon into a real monster.
All the better to crush your pathetic resistance.
One thing you ought to know about Overwatch, we don't go down easy.
I am counting on it.
Give my thanks to your parents for letting us operate out of their home. And sorry for all the noise.
Oh, don't worry about that. Mama says it's the quietest the workshop has been in years.
You deployed to Tokyo against orders? Careless decisions like this got Overwatch shut down in the first place.
I have spent a lifetime running from my responsibilities. It is time I face them.
How are your experiments with the enhancement serum progressing?
Progress cannot be rushed. When I have the results, you'll be the first to know.
Time is of the essence, Moira.
Uh, new overseer, same impatience.
You've enjoyed Talon's protection long enough. Soon, you must declare your loyalty.
And what happens if I don't?
Then I will hunt you down myself.
You want to play my game? I thought you hated losing.
You stand no chance against the Hashimoto. If you so readily welcome their informant into your ranks.
The Yokai aren't an army, we're a family. Not surprised you don't understand.
I see you have returned to honor your father's legacy at last.
You are mistaken. My brother and I fight for each other and the future we might build together.
If that is all you desire, it is an embarrassment the Hashimoto cannot handle you themselves.
Do you miss your life before Overwatch? Training for your sport, your family, your home?
Absolutely. I never thought my journey would take me so far from those I love.
How do you manage?
The same way as you. We just do.
*(swooning beeps)*
I'm not quite sure what you said, but I know a compliment when I hear one.
*(bashful beeps)*
*(melodic beeps)*
Enough. One more note, and I'm putting that bird in a cage.
*(horrified beeps)*
What? You don't like that? Fine. Then I'll clip its wings instead.
Ashe, I've been thinking since Grand Mesa what you said about switching sides.
Uh-huh. And you realized Overwatch has been your real home all along.
No, not that. I'm thinking you might have a point.
Huh. Maybe they didn't brainwash you after all.
You disappoint me, Ramattra. A tactician such as yourself should know the consequences of breaking alliances.
And a mastermind such as you must know to always anticipate betrayal.
Torbjörn Lindholm harboring an Efi Oladele. Never thought I'd see the day.
*(refuting beeps)*
Ask him yourself, but it's not my story to tell.
Fighting's about to start. Time to do what they built you for
*(cautious, inquiring beeps)*
They think you're still a killing machine, even if you're wearing a hat.
With the return of Toshiro sensei, Asa sensei seems happier than before.
In my eyes, she is just as stormy as I remember.
Think again, brother. She did not beat us with a sword at the moment we greeted her.
Hm. An astute observation.
Seeing Keiko's family reunited makes me think of mother. I hope she's well.
Genji, let us not speak of her.
Is it so wrong to lament her absence?
She wanted nothing more than to be rid of the Shimada name. We must honor that.
I'm sure Toshiro sensei would be willing to repair your old sword.
No. That chipped blade must serve as an eternal reminder of my wrongdoing.
But, without its Shimada master, the dragon within will slumber forever.
I know. It deserves to be laid to rest.
It appalled me to see what dismal blades Toshiro sensei crafted for the Hashimoto.
Yes, I am glad he no longer has to stifle his creativity.
Kiriko's faith in her friends clouded my judgment. I should have listened to my instincts about you.
I'm sorry. I hope helping break out Genji and Toshiro-san proves that.
That is the only reason I have not yet cut you down.
I always wondered how Sakura's intel was so accurate. You were feeding her Hashimoto's secrets the whole time.
Actually, that was all her. Don't let my mistakes shake your faith in the other yokai.
Second one of those junkers starts giving you trouble, just let me know, will you?
*(appreciative beeps)*

conversations.name: More than we are made for

lines.subtitles: Folks get the wrong idea about you often, Bastion.
*(sad, affirmative beep)*
But you can't let it get you down. We're more than we're made for.
Do you really go digging for bits of old pottery?
Of course. They're called shards, and they're amazing.
What could be amazing about broken junk?
The story it tells when you put it back together.
You know, my parents were soldiers, too.
Really? You must be proud of all they fought for.
Pride's in short supply. I'm not wasting it on them.
Can you make the sound of a vicuña?
*(vicuña noises)*
That was pretty close. I'm impressed.
Before everything happened, Chiyo and I carried potatoes through the mountains together. I miss those days.
If you recently upgraded my weight-bearing capacity, perhaps I could carry potatoes for you.
That would be nice.
I made another blunder during training. Was I not meant for this?
Stop questioning yourself. If you were not proficient, we would not have you join the fight.
I want to get over Mizuki's past with the Hashimoto, but I don't know if I can.
Forgiveness heals the forgiver, Kiriko. You will find the peace when you learn to let go.
If he truly is worth forgiving, he should not expect you to.
So, what would it take for you to let someone ride you into battle?
There are two conditions. They must be worthy, and they must ask nicely.
Mhm, bad news for Hanzo, then.
Sloan, my dear friend, have you recovered anything else from that vault?
Have I ever? It's going to take years to go through all these artifacts.
Well, I hope you don't get buried under all that documentation.
I heard you live under knowledge itself. What more could they have hoped for?
I wonder how you'd look busting a move.
Sometimes imagination should take precedence over reality.
Woah, a Bastion unit. Big fan of the carnage you guys dish out.
*(nervous protesting beeps)*
Don't be shy. Take the credit where it's due.
I heard you ran into my little buddy Sloan out in the Atlantic.
Ugh, yes, that intolerable vagrant. Oh, if only they had sunk with all their trinkets.
Next time they bother you, just smash some old pottery. That really gets them heated.
Nothing like a few bullets to kick off a party. Am I right?
Oh, yes. A little mayhem always revs my engine.
You were asleep for a long time, too, weren't you?
*(nodding beeps)*
Well, we don't have to be lonely anymore. Not with all the friends we have in Overwatch.
*(excited beeps)*
How did you survive the years after the crisis?
*(snoring beeps)*
That's rather a long nap.
I see you survived. What a pity.
I am difficult to kill.
Until you're not.
You let your empire slip through your fingers. Strength wasted.
And your allegiance crumbled the moment it was tested.
It was a liability masked as opportunity. If I stayed, we would both be obsolete.
Though we could not reach an accord here, Zenyatta, it still meant a great deal to see you again.
Our roads may lead us apart, Ramattra, but you will always be my brother.
What are we waiting for? The more time we waste, the harder it'll be to put Vendetta down.
I will not approach this fight in overconfidence. We will have one chance, and we will make it count.
All right, warriors. Are we ready to achieve victory at all costs?
*(eager beeps)*
Huh. I will take that as a yes.
Zarya Volskaya, do you remember all the tricks we learned together?
How could I forget? Let's show them what we can do.
You still know how to rain bullets, don't you? I think our enemies might look better bullet-ridden.
*(refusing beeps)*
I don't like your tone, E54.
What's Vendetta complaining for? She got her sword. The other ones were inferior anyway.
Let it out, Shi-Shi. Really stick it to her.
That anima could rip her armor to pieces. She'd be nothing without the Hashimoto!
I know. She's totally cramping your style!
I love that you have two hearts. One for each of my pistols to shoot clean through.
And a gal with no heart is just my type.
It's time to stand down, Vendetta. Overwatch took out your allies in Tokyo and we won't stop there.
If you believe I cannot survive a single loss, then you have misjudged my competence to a fatal degree.
Could never fault your confidence, Zarya. I think it's rubbed off on all our new recruits, too.
Confidence makes victory. Victory makes confidence. It is not so hard to understand.
When you put it that way, it really isn't.
So, what's the plan to take down Vendetta?
There is no plan.
But, you always have a plan. We have to do something.
And we will. When the time is right, Vendetta's empire will be felled by action, not schemes.
You may not have accomplished all that I desired, but what you did deliver shows great potential.
Potential? I handed you carnage in a pretty package.
It takes more than a honed edge to earn my praise. A weapon must prove itself in battle.
You should thank the Wayfinders for fishing up those artifacts after you tried to sink them.
Ah, they're still intact. Perhaps I ought to repossess them.
Not on, lady. Those relics were never yours to begin with.
Oh, hey. That symbol on your chest, I've seen that before.
You have? Where?
I think it was in a ruin in Greece, or maybe Kenya? Wait, wait, it'll come to me.
Yeah. Take your time.
Hey, you noticing our names start the same way? You know, Venture, Vendetta.
You are never to speak to me again. Do you understand?
Oh, uh, yes, ma'am. Sorry, ma'am.
Yeah, no sweat, team. I'll have those baddies out of commission before you can say radiocarbon dating.
Radiocarbon dating?
Wait, no fair. I was ready.
In my country, they tell a crazy story about you. I must know if it is true.
I don't see what's so remarkable about doing surgery on yourself in a blizzard.
The knitting needle and the bear? Unfortunately, yes.
It was only an 8 kilometre shot. I've done better since.
To be fair, the wolf bit me first.
I knew it.
Anran, I hear you don't have a spotter! We should synchronize our gym schedules.
I'd love that! I feel so motivated when I watch you train.
Well, that makes two of us.
It is rare to find such discipline in someone so young. I commend you.
That's just how I was trained. It's nothing special.
Wrong. Take the compliment, girl.
I once had a cat like you. My sisters and I would bring her on ice fishing trips.
*(eager meowing)*
That coat won't keep you warm enough. But all that blubber might do the trick.
You should not judge all humans for the actions of a rotten few.
Strange advice from the woman with wires still caught in her portrait.
I've learned better than to blame omnics for what my people went through.
Well, I'm so glad you got something out of all those years of hatred.
The world's hardships have steeled you. But there is still kindness in your eyes.
Save it, bot. You're not the first to lecture me.
Not the first, and I hope for your sake not the last.
Genji, I bring good news. I have plans with someone special this Valentine's Day.
Oh. Who?
His name is Zenyatta.
Master.
You have changed much about yourself since your awakening.
Why stay in a form humans built? There's no beauty in their crude design.
Perhaps true beauty is found within, sister.
You lost me at sister, monk.
You know, the first year without my mom... it was real hard. Didn't open up for a while.
I did not have the luxury of time to grieve. My family needed my strength.
And now they're grown! When it comes to feeling your feelings, it's better late than never.
I... I will keep that in mind.
So... why did we really stop writing? I know my sketch wasn't that terrible.
Conflict got in the way. It is as you say: "war takes every happiness".
An unfortunate truth. But... we're still friends, aren't we?
Nothing could ever take that from us.
You've been with Overwatch a long time. Any advice for a new recruit?
Hmm... never lose sight of your teammates.
Well, you're the last person I'd expect to hear that from!
It is important to learn from our mistakes.
You'll like this one: How does a non-binary ninja take out a target?
Uh... how?
How?
I'll bite. How?
They slash them!
Oh. They should try shurikens too.
I suppose I've heard worse jokes.
Oh, good one! Bet you a hundred yen Genji doesn't get it.
Ajaraka mokuren tekerettsuno pa!
Um... Gesundheit?
I was trying to get rid of that grim Reaper for you, but... he's still here.
*(annoyed grumble)*
You gonna reap souls without a scythe?
Guns get the job done. If you'd ever fired one, you'd know.
Okay, hand me yours. Let's see what I can do.
Overwatch is back. I'm surprised you aren't to blame.
I have plenty of trouble without dredging up old mistakes.
Hmph. We finally agree on something.
Gabriel Reyes... I know that name. Soldier 24, right?
Nobody calls me that anymore.
Well, I'm not about to call you "Reaper".
Then... don't call me anything.
Cheers love! It's time to save the world!
Oh, what? Again?
It's a perfect day for some mayhem!
That's what I am always sayin'!
Ugh. Entered my passcode too quick and now I'm locked out of my phone!
I can unlock it for you, cariño.
Thanks, love! Oh-- wait. You tryna pull a fast one on me?
Hm. You're smarter than you look.
I happened upon some artifacts in an old necropolis. Would you care to look after them?
Would I?!
I should warn you, they might be cursed...
Ah! Even better!
No way... you're Echo! Like, Mina Liao's Echo! Oh, I have so many questions for you!
I... suppose I could answer them.
Awesome! I don't even know where to start, uh, I mean, um... what was she like?
She was... like me.
I understand you study omnic archaeology.
It's only my favorite specialization!
What do you know of the Awakening? Could Aurora's sentience be replicated?
That one... might be beyond my expertise.
...and, unlike with base 10, you begin at the rightmost number and work left.
Right. But... when did you pick your pronouns? Did you... download those?
Do you believe we are discussing "non-binary", rather than the binary counting system?
Oh! Uh... yeah.
Better watch it, kid, or those relics might end up in my pocket.
Don't do that! You don't even know their cultural value!
Uh, I know the value of 'a lot of money'.
Well... I know the value of... 'bopping you on the head'!
When are you gonna give me my cut of all those treasures?
When are you gonna stop being a big doofus?!
You first.
You second! Oh... shoot.
You're a geneticist? If you're up for it, I bet our bioarchaeology team would love to have you!
The dead tell intriguing tales. But my interest lies with the living.
Hey! ¡Quiúbole, Gabrielito! How's it hangin'?
What did you call me?
"Gabrielito"! That's your nickname, right?
*(growl)* Sombra...
So... you haven't been in touch since Ilios.
Be patient, escuincle. You aren't the only piece in this puzzle.
But what kind of puzzle? Lockbox, ancient riddle, jigsaw?
*(sigh)* Whatever kind makes you stop asking questions.
You might've gotten away from me once, but I won't quit until you're both behind bars.
*(chuckle)* I'm working with the world's best bounty hunter. Good luck tracking us down.
If your tracking skills are like the security at Grand Mesa, I expect I'll be fine.
The Naughton Vault requires top security clearance. How'd you get your intel?
Sorry, kid. Confidentiality's just as important in my line of work as it is in yours.
Then as a professional, you know I have to get answers.
Let this one go. For your own good.
Ooh... I think I went a bit overboard on the weights yesterday.
Pace yourself! That's what I always tell Reinhardt. Not that he ever listens.
Hey, can I look at the wings on your suit again?
I thought you preferred to stay on the ground.
It's for a different idea I had. I-I just thought the view from up there would be... inspirational.
Hey, rocket lady... do they make that suit in my size?
*laughter* Oh, you couldn't handle one of these.
Why not?! I was born to fly...
I see your sneakers. You, me, the basketball courts later.
Sure. But I don't play without stakes.
Likewise. What are you willing to lose?
Oh, Pharah-chan... I've never lost.
I don't work with criminals.
What's right isn't always what's legal.
Then you change the laws.
Heh, easy for you to say.
I think I'm going to get a chihuahua.
You're joking.
Why, what's wrong with chihuahuas?
Uh, well, for starters, they aren't corgis.
Can't believe Ana Amari's kid took up with mercenaries like Helix.
Oh, as opposed to, whatever you are?
Y'know, Fareeha, it's not a sign of weakness if you take it easy sometimes.
Mistakes arise when people turn careless.
*(sigh)* Like mother, like daughter...
Just like we practiced, Amari: I pull them together, you blow them up!
I'm not waiting, I'm going to blow them up right away!
Yes, but when I pull them together, then you blow them up especially.
Better watch your back, now. Helix is going to wipe your whole operation off the map.
I reckon they'll try. But when I'm through, the West'll be wild again.
How are you liking working with Overwatch, Sierra?
Oh, it's amazing! Y'all are so smart, and kind, and... well, nothing beats working with heroes!
*chuckle* That's exactly what I've been hearing about you, too.
I've had my problems with Helix, but I'll be damned if they don't train up some real sharpshooters.
Careful now, cowboy. That's almost a compliment.
I think you could use an adventure, Mei! You ever hike Mount Washington?
No, but I've read about it. They have such interesting weather patterns there.
Yeah, and the fog stretches for miles. I'll take you with me next time.
I'm glad you joined us. We're going to need all the help we can get to take Talon down.
Hah, my mom always told me to stand up for what's right. And it doesn't get much more wrong than Talon.
So what exactly are you looking to learn about Jack Morrison?
Honestly? Whatever you've got.
You were the Enhancement Program's best soldier. There's gotta be something you can tell me.
The Naughton project's ancient history. It's been shut down for decades.
Your "ancient history" is all I've got to go on.
Trust me, kid: the last thing you need is my past catching up to you, too.
You know, you're not the only one chasing down leads. Maybe we can help each other.
Some things stay buried for a reason. Digging them up can get you killed.
Yeah? When did that ever stop you?
Guess that's fair.
Whoof, Dorothy's looking a little worse for wear after that last mission...
Just swing by my workshop after this. I'll patch her up.
Wow! You mean it, Dr. Lindholm? That'd be amazing!
Please, Dr. Lindholm is my wife!
You still have any contacts with Los Muertos?
I might. What's in it for me?
I'd offer you money, but I don't think that's what you're after.
No. So... any good stories about the cowboy?
You'll never guess what I heard when I tapped the Hashimoto's calls.
I don't do guesses. What's your price?
*(tongue click)* I have a feeling we're going to get along.
That fox girl asked for more Hashimoto intel. Think I should tell her the truth?
Only if you're prepared to regret it.
Your friends might be fooled by your little act, but I know a liar when I see one.
I'm not lying. Just not telling the whole truth.
Sure, whatever helps you sleep at night.
Peeked at your grades. Pretty good for someone studying through a Null Sector attack.
Thanks! Honestly, I'm pretty proud of-- oh, HEY! That's private!
Not to me.
Jamison Fawkes, channel nine news. Mr. Gunbot, sir, how do you think the battle's going to go?
*(excited, talkative beeps)*
Could you repeat that in words? Hold on, breaking news! The moon has fallen into the ocean!
Can I get a beat?
*(beep-boxes)*
*(beep-boxes)*
Haha, perfect! You're the best.
One stick o' dynamite? Well, that's just adorable.
BOB!
I meant admirable! Admirable!
You rob any trains in your day?
Argh, they get all gummed up together in a big pile when I try!
...You're supposed to stop them first.
I do stop them. I think my problem is that I stop them a little too hard...
What's on your mind, mate?
I am thinking of what I have lost.
What, your keys? Arrows? Snacks? I've got snacks. Cheer up!
We should do a concert together.
Oh, what do you play?
I sing. Laaaa... *continues singing*
I sing. La la la la la la... *singing scales*
I-I sing! *high operatic singing*
I sing. Figaro, figaro-figaro-figaro-figaro, figaro... ooh-ooooh!
Wow. Yeah, uh... I'll have to get back to you on that.
*half-whispering:* Look, he's the strangest bot I've ever seen. That's all I'm sayin'.
Strangeness is in the eye of the beholder.
Oh no, he heard me. This is so awkward...
Jamison Fawkes, interviewing this fancy robot. Any wisdom to share with us as the battle begins?
Victory goes to those who maintain their focus.
Boring! Back to you, Natasha—any car chases we could watch?
Dr. Zhou. Did Captain Opara make it back as well?
I'm afraid not.
*(sigh)* He was a good man.
He thought the same about you.
Dr. Zhou! You've made quite the name for yourself.
Oh, thank you! I think there's always more to learn.
Quit being so humble. Nothing wrong with being proud of your work!
I may have another opportunity to travel to Rio de Janeiro. Do you have any feedback for the board?
Yeah, I do. Stay out of my city.
Do my eyes deceive me, or are you wearin' skates?
Nice skates. Very cute. You goin' to swap those out before we get to the gunfight?
Y'all, our teammate is wearin' skates. To a gunfight! Hahaha!
You'll see what these can do!
Time to settle who's the best shot.
There is no competition. I was trained by the best.
And I was trained by the West.
**sighs** Americans.
That rifle is a fine piece of work. Looks a little unwieldy, though
Perhaps in the hands of an amateur
You remind me of myself when I was younger.
Uh, I'm way cooler than you!
That's exactly what I would've said! All you're missin' is the hat and cigar.
Weighted like a stone. Blade, sharpened - yearns to punish. Strikes the final blow.
Swifter than the wind. A rushing crimson river. Stains the earth with red.
**groans** You're reciting your haikus out loud again...
The Shimada weapons were masterworks, but those ofuda were your father's magnum opus.
He made them for grandma when he proposed. Bringing the fox spirit to life really won her over.
A sentimental, yet powerful gift. I see why she was impressed.
Is it true that my dad had to keep the fox spirit a secret from the clan?
Indeed. He was forbidden from crafting more anima avatars after forging our dragons.
Why? You used them to help people.
The scenes that haunt my memories... prove otherwise.
Do you think Genji will ever come back?
Have faith, Kiriko. The years have changed us all, but he will return just as I have.
Have you heard from your father?
A little. It's been harder to contact him since you escaped the Hashimoto.
I did not wish to make matters worse for him. I'm sorry.
**reassuring sigh** Don't be. I'm sure he's just glad you're back.
The Hashimoto run hourly patrols. We can sneak into the castle when they change shifts.
I am... impressed. Your preparations are quite diligent.
Well, I had to kill time until someone came back...
Right. Then I will make your patience worthwhile.
My mom wants to know if you've kept up with the sword.
I swore... never to wield a blade again.
Mm. I'll tell her you're thinking of picking it back up.
Send my greetings to... Asa-sensei.
You can say hi yourself.
In the mood to follow my orders today, Song?
If those orders involve me wrecking the bad guys, you bet!
**chuckles** I'll see what I can do.
So... how is that man you were telling me about?
Angela, I'm not discussing my love life on a mission.
Lúcio, have you ever written lyrics before?
I've dabbled a bit. What's up?
I was wondering if you would look at... Actually, I'm going to work on it a bit more.
Listened to your album the other day.
Oh, uh... did you like it?
Not sure there was enough bass. I could almost hear the other sounds.
Ha! I'll crank it up next time.
You check out the new Antler Antler album?
You've heard of them?
Yeah. So... what'd you think?
Nobody uses fifteen electric guitars like those guys!
You've come a long way since joining Overwatch. I'm thankful to have your support.
Aw, back at'cha! It's all about relying on each other.
To give into impulse is to give up control.
**questioning meows**
That is to say, please refrain from swatting the orbs.
**pouty meows**
So, how'd you pull all those heists?
Bombs!
Uh huh. And...?
Was-- w-was there supposed to be another step?
Get this: more bombs!
Bought another Lucky Lucky Good Luck Amulet. I have a good feeling about today.
I hope you don't buy those often. Pretty sure they're a scam.
Every week since I got to Kanezaka.
See... this is why you're broke.
Kiriko. I really need your help.
What's wrong?
I lost this week's Lucky Lucky Good Luck Amulet...
There, there. I'll pray for you later.
Not sure Hanzo likes me much.
Oh, don't take it personal. He thinks everyone's suspicious.
Aw, but I'm such a stand-up guy. You trust me, right?
Uh... not when you say it like that...
Tell Ryōta to stop tagging on Hashimoto turf. If they catch him, he's screwed.
Mizuki... You're actually a huge softie, aren't you?
Quit messing around. Don't you know what they do to people that piss them off?
Relax, I'll talk to him. It's just funny you try to hide how much you care.
Where were you last night? Chikasa said she couldn't get a hold of you.
If I told you, I'd have to kill you.
Ugh. Can't you answer normally for once?
Nah. I like making you mad.
Your new hat looks lighter. Nobuto did a good job.
Yeah, I like it. Wish it was a little more lowkey, though.
Right? If the Hashimoto find out what he can make, they'll paint a target on his back for sure.
They do love a fashion statement.
You have a bandage?
Who exactly do you think I am?
Someone who carries bandages? Guess not.
Yikes... You look cheery.
**scoff** As cheery as you are significant.
Angela! **chuckle** I can call you Angela, right?
For you? Doctor Ziegler.
Aw... I'm a little hurt... "Doctor".
Dr. Ziegler, you should join us next time we run drills! I feel like I only ever see you in the lab.
